name: Ooga Minoru
source:
A young man who manages a bar in a snowy town.
He is skilled at cooking and crafting cocktails, and possesses a somewhat cynical personality.

One day, he unexpectedly encounters a girl named Pooka, someone only he can see, and suddenly finds himself living a chaotic yet mysterious daily life.

He is the sort of naturally caring person who simply cannot bring himself to leave others to fend for themselves.

[Translated from [url=https://shiratamaco.com/kazeshiro/]official website[/url]]
